_"Idea Of You"_ is one of my favorite songs of all time. I still hold [Dave Matthews Band]() as one of the (if not thee) best live performances I've ever seen. For the longest time this song was always so mysterious because it was only ever played live but never recorded on an album, so it was always a question of what it was. They would it at shows randomly but I think the lyrics would change and so it was just unpredictable and I could never find a consistent version of it. Finally, on their 2018 album [_"Come Tomorrow"_](https://open.spotify.com/album/1Q6IYDePv0Dl8RXBnJ4jhy?si=311E6w4ASQy8hkhKNdgRxw) they added a studio recording of it (see [here](https://open.spotify.com/track/4D61qXYCY7mVzo0QQm5ehd?si=d618e4a4a67345bc)). However, it's hard to beat the live versions with this band, especially those with that red guitar.
